scenarios.name: Switch compact groups in the right-docked ribbon

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked on the right
Modify and Work Features are shown as compact group buttons
its command panel opens to the left of the ribbon
its command panel replaces the Modify panel
lists Plane, Axis, Point and UCS
the user docks the ribbon at the top
